name: PairPad
label: Collaborative software
summary: A shared workspace for writing code, solving problems, and building together. In real time.
subtitle: Real-time collaborative coding
description: A full-stack platform for pair programming, technical interviews, and shared development.
highlights: CRDT-based shared editing with remote cursors and live presence.
Collaborative workspaces, role-based access, and revision history.
Integrated code execution, interview mode, and live chat.

name: ShadowCast
label: Distributed systems
summary: What if browsers helped power the web? A decentralized engine for peer-to-peer asset delivery.
subtitle: Decentralized content delivery
description: Browsers share static website assets directly through WebRTC, designed to reduce reliance on origin-server bandwidth.
highlights: Multi-peer chunk distribution with SHA-256 integrity verification.
Service worker interception and persistent browser caching.
A Go signaling backend coordinates peer connections.

name: RuralShield AI
label: Explainable AI
summary: Helping banking users understand suspicious messages, with detection that explains its reasoning.
subtitle: Explainable phishing detection
description: A privacy-first phishing and scam detection platform designed for banking users.
highlights: Combines machine learning, deterministic rules, and URL analysis.
Risk scores, AI explanations, multilingual support, and actionable recommendations.
Serverless AWS architecture using Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, and DynamoDB.

name: VibeBridge
label: Developer tools
summary: A controlled bridge between AI assistance and your local development workspace.
subtitle: Local MCP execution bridge
description: Connects Gemini Spark to a developer's workspace through the Model Context Protocol.
highlights: AI-assisted file operations, codebase search, and source editing.
Terminal execution with workspace restrictions and permission controls.
Activity logging for visibility into local actions.

name: Zentra
label: Digital wellbeing
summary: More intentional screen time. An offline-first Android app for focus and digital wellbeing.
subtitle: Native Android productivity
description: A digital wellbeing application that brings screen-time analytics and productivity tracking together.
highlights: Weighted Focus Score, weekly usage trends, and app limits.
Pomodoro sessions, Deep Focus mode, and mindfulness interventions.
Local persistence with Room and an offline-first MVVM architecture.

name: Argus
label: AI & automation
summary: AI-assisted moderation with practical safeguards for busy Telegram communities.
subtitle: Telegram group management
description: A moderation bot combining AI content analysis with rule-based security mechanisms.
highlights: Spam detection, anti-raid protection, CAPTCHA verification, and flood control.
Configurable moderation filters and a plugin architecture.
Response caching and structured monitoring.

name: VeloSphere
label: Native graphics
summary: A synthwave 3D endless runner, built natively without a conventional game engine.
subtitle: Native 3D Android arcade
description: A native Android endless runner exploring the graphics and gameplay systems beneath a game engine.
highlights: Custom C++17 game loop and OpenGL ES 3.0 rendering.
Procedural GLSL shaders and a synthwave visual environment.
Physics-based gameplay, dynamic obstacles, and jumping mechanics.

name: HazardLens
label: Simulation
summary: Exploring industrial disaster scenarios through digital twins and 3D simulation.
subtitle: Industrial disaster digital twin
description: A simulation platform for estimating industrial fire and explosion threat zones.
highlights: Models equipment, storage vessels, pipelines, safety systems, and environmental conditions.
Simulates cascading events, thermal radiation, vapor cloud dispersion, and structural damage.
Supports comparison of emergency response strategies.

name: Recon Suite
label: Security tooling
summary: Modular domain reconnaissance and clear reporting for authorized security assessments.
subtitle: Authorized domain reconnaissance
description: A modular Python toolkit for domain discovery during authorized security assessments.
highlights: Passive subdomain enumeration using multiple intelligence sources.
Concurrent DNS brute-force discovery and DNS record detection.
HTML/PDF reports, configurable workers, progress tracking, and fallback handling.
